Name: Fixed Female Farmer Pants
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
The default female farmer pants have many spots in many animations where leg pixels show outside of the pants. They have haunted me. I have hunted them down and eliminated them.

This mod has both a Fashion Sense version and a Content Patcher version. The Content Patcher version replaces the default female farmer pants. The Fashion Sense version is additional for if you want to control your whole outfit with Fashion Sense.
